headline: Zero-install EV drift game with real weight-transfer physics
text:
A drifting game in a single HTML file where your EV battery is your health bar.

Real weight-transfer physics + regen braking on slide.

Can you beat the dev ghost on today's Daily Road? ⚡️🏎️

https://kreeda.games/drift/index.html #gamedev #webdev #indiedev
mediaSuggestion: A fast-paced 5-7s looping 60fps clip showing a clean countersteer drift around a snowy bend, battery HUD flashing green with regen, cleanly overtaking the translucent dev ghost.
